topics.title: Burt Parks and Miss America Frustration
topics.summary: During a radio show, callers repeatedly express frustration with Gary Collin as the new Miss America. One caller, Jack Rowley, demands Burt Parks return to the pageant due to his dislike of Collin’s selection, leading into discussions about personal relationships and desires for contentment within families.

topics.title: Nose Mishaps and Fantasies
topics.summary: During a radio segment, callers discuss bizarre scenarios including using Oprah’s panty lines and attempting to steal thoughts. A heated debate ensues about Howard's behavior with Judy, culminating in accusations of inappropriate actions and fantasies involving breasts, while also discussing outlandish romantic encounters like sucking fat for homeless shelters or giving Roseanne Barabat a Valentine’s gift.

topics.title: Radio Show Argument
topics.summary: During a radio show, Sam and Judy become embroiled in an escalating argument following perceived slights and reactions to earlier comments. Accusations of overreacting are exchanged amidst awkward attempts at reconciliation involving references to Dr. Ruth and other unrelated topics, ultimately ending with a desire for peace.

topics.title: Stern Promotes Video Contest & Mishaps
topics.summary: During the broadcast, Howard discusses a video contest offering cash prizes for submissions showcasing unusual or embarrassing personal behavior – including farting in public and filming medical procedures—while frequently mispronouncing names and engaging in playful banter with listeners.

topics.title: Bartman's Persistent Attempts to Contact Iranians
topics.summary: During a radio broadcast, host Bartman repeatedly attempts to connect with Iranian contacts via telephone, expressing frustration and nonsensical statements about his abilities while discussing perceived fear of the Iranians. The calls are largely unsuccessful due to technical difficulties and misdirected connections.

topics.title: Radio Host Discusses ‘Satanic Verses’ with Fart-Related Claims
topics.summary: A radio host engages in a nonsensical conversation, repeatedly questioning callers about the book 'The Satanic Verses' while introducing bizarre claims involving fart power and personal attacks against Libyan leader Muammar Gaddafi. The discussion culminates in assertions of American exceptionalism.
